O.outcome_detail: User experience ratings across six UEQ categories; all category means were above the positive-evaluation threshold of 0.8.

cells.quote: All 6 UEQ categories were positively evaluated. Attractiveness (mean 2.064, SD 0.672) and stimulation (mean 1.827, SD 0.949) were the highest-rated categories, whereas dependability was the lowest-rated category (mean 1.115, SD 0.740; Figure 1).
cells.note: Single-group formative usability evaluation; the study reports descriptive UEQ ratings rather than an experimental comparison or printed effect size.
